Name: Animal Swap
Author: SirPipocado
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Rearranging animals in vanilla is a pain. If you want a cow in one barn and a goat in the other to switch places, you have to move one somewhere else first, then the other, then move the first one back. And that’s assuming you even have a free spot.
Animal Swap adds a small button to the animal menu that does it in one go. Pick the building, pick the animal, done. They swap homes.
[line]
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Start the game, click on any coop or barn animal and look for the new button.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Swap button[/b] in the animal menu, right above the vanilla “move home” button.[/*]
[*][b]Pick the building from a farm view[/b], the same way the game does when you move an animal. The camera starts on the animal’s current home.[/*]
[*][b]Then pick who to swap with[/b] from a list of the animals living in that building.[/*]
[*][b]Only valid swaps show up.[/b] Both animals have to be able to live in each other’s building, so a duck still needs a Big Coop and a pig still needs a Deluxe Barn.[/*]
[*][b]Works even if the animal is outside[/b] on the pasture when you swap.[/*]
[*][b]Nothing breaks halfway:[/b] everything is checked before any animal is moved. If something’s off, nothing changes.[/*]
[*][b]Controller support.[/b][/*]
[*][b]English and Brazilian Portuguese.[/b] It follows your game language.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[/list]No config, nothing else needed.
[line]
[b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to ConcernedApe for the game and Pathoschild for SMAPI.

Manifest.Name: Animal Swap
Manifest.Description: Adds a swap button to the animal menu to trade two coop or barn animals between buildings.
